title: fix: keep one paid app-spend quest
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Retires the 15-Pollen first-paid-request quest; its card remains for existing rewards.
- Awards 10 Pollen when other users spend 3 Paid Pollen across your apps. Own usage and Quest Pollen do not count.
- Keeps the existing quest IDs and historical reward amounts; no migration or Tinybird change.
- All 39 quest tests pass.

gist.headline: One garden, one reward
gist.blurb: The app-spend quest now follows a single, useful trail: when other people spend 3 Paid Pollen in your apps, 10 Pollen lands back in your wallet. The old first-paid-request card stays around so past rewards keep their history.
gist.summary: Consolidated paid app-spend quest behavior so the existing quest awards 10 Pollen after other users spend 3 Paid Pollen across an app creator's apps, while excluding the creator's own usage and Quest Pollen.
gist.impact: App builders now have one clear 10-Pollen growth reward tied to 3 Paid Pollen of real external app usage, with existing quest IDs and historical rewards preserved.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper combining two nearby quest signposts into one healthy code-plant. Three small Paid Pollen coins arrive from friendly app visitors, bloom into a 10-Pollen reward flower, and an older signpost remains gently preserved in the background to represent retained reward history.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but beautiful.
